movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_wheel[1-4]_01
movable_parts.motion: Four caster wheels that both roll along the floor for movement and swivel 360 degrees for steering.
movable_parts.axis: Y for roll, Z for swivel

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_lader4_01
movable_parts.motion: The entire tabletop assembly moves vertically for height adjustment via a telescoping column.

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_table_01
movable_parts.motion: The entire tabletop can tilt forward/backward (Trendelenburg, approx. +/- 30 degrees) and tilt laterally side-to-side (approx. +/- 20 degrees).
movable_parts.axis: X for lateral, Y for longitudinal

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_frame1_01
movable_parts.motion: The backrest section pivots up and down, from a declined position to a seated position.

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_headrest_01
movable_parts.motion: The headrest section, attached to the backrest, pivots up and down to position the patient's head.

movable_parts.name: sm_surgicaltable_a01_frame2_01
movable_parts.motion: The leg rest assembly, which is split into two independent left and right sections. Each section can pivot down from the main table and also has a second pivot point for a 'knee' bend.
movable_parts.range_description: approx. -90 to +15 degrees for main joint; -90 to +30 for 'knee' joint

special_notes: This is a complex, multi-articulated surgical table. The main structure is stainless steel with padded foam cushions on the top surfaces. The telescoping lift mechanism (lader1-4) can be simplified to a single prismatic joint. Caster wheels require both roll and swivel joints. The leg rests are split and have two articulation points each (hip and knee).
